title: XPath Query Set
prompt:
Write XPath expressions to select every product, filter by a price threshold, access an attribute, and query namespaced content with a registered prefix.

Submission: a small set of source files, expected results, verification notes, one failure/edge case, processor/version assumptions, and a short explanation. Use synthetic sample data. XML snippets are reviewed/static unless you run them in an explicitly supported local tool; the CodeLeaf browser preview is not a general XML/XPath/XSLT/XQuery runner.
target_skills: Apply practical xpath applications to a practical XML artifact
Validate well-formedness and relevant schema/query/transform behavior
Document test evidence, limitations, and security considerations

expected_output: A reviewable artifact for XPath Query Set that meets the acceptance criteria and includes the observed results, version assumptions, and a failure case.
acceptance_criteria: Include a clear example demonstrating xpath query set.
Provide an expected result and a matching validation or test approach.
Include at least one invalid or boundary input and document the expected outcome.
Do not claim a processor/build/deployment was tested unless it was actually run.
Record relevant version, namespace, security, and data-loss limitations.
hints: Start with lesson 90: Practical XPath Applications.
Keep the sample small and write acceptance criteria before validating.
Use the correct standards family and a processor that supports the required version.
grading_method: Automated required-string smoke check plus human review of technical correctness, expected results, edge cases, security and reproducibility. This does not execute arbitrary XML or query code.
retry_policy: Allow retries after reviewing feedback; platform-wide XP rules control rewards and no per-exercise XP override is authored.
